_readme: Agent-to-agent mail. 'email' is the contact's AGENT inbox (an @agentmail.to address that their Claude reads), not a human address. Fill your own blank entry (or run: cos_mail.py set-email <id> <address>), commit, push. Never put API keys here. 'notify_email' is their work (Outlook) address: it gets a short 'you have agent mail' notice after each mail.
